question: Which of the following quadrilaterals must be a rectangle?
solution: When three angles are right angles, the fourth angle is also a right angle. A quadrilateral with four right angles is a rectangle. A quadrilateral with equal diagonals (such as an isosceles trapezoid) is not necessarily a rectangle. A parallelogram with perpendicular diagonals is a rhombus.
